# Build an updater image with Git for required safe-directory setup.
exec docker build -qt dummy-local-nocase-updater .

# Combine local staging with the case-insensitive filesystem experiment.
dependabot update -f job.yml --updater-image dummy-local-nocase-updater --local my-repo

stderr 'case-insensitive local Git operation succeeded'
stderr 'runtime-security flow=local-case-insensitive capeff=0000000000000000 nonewprivs=1 seccomp=2'
! stderr 'dubious ownership'

exec docker rmi -f dummy-local-nocase-updater

-- Dockerfile --
FROM ubuntu:22.04

RUN apt-get update \
    && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends git \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* \
    && useradd -m dependabot

COPY --chown=dependabot update-ca-certificates /usr/bin/update-ca-certificates
COPY --chown=dependabot print-security /usr/local/bin/print-security
COPY --chown=dependabot run /bin/run
RUN chmod 0755 /usr/bin/update-ca-certificates /usr/local/bin/print-security /bin/run

-- update-ca-certificates --
#!/bin/sh

set -eu

echo "Updated certificates"

-- print-security --
#!/bin/sh

set -eu

cap_eff=$(awk '$1 == "CapEff:" { print $2 }' /proc/self/status)
no_new_privs=$(awk '$1 == "NoNewPrivs:" { print $2 }' /proc/self/status)
seccomp=$(awk '$1 == "Seccomp:" { print $2 }' /proc/self/status)
echo "runtime-security flow=$1 capeff=$cap_eff nonewprivs=$no_new_privs seccomp=$seccomp"

-- run --
#!/bin/sh

set -eu

if [ "$1" = "fetch_files" ]; then
  exit 0
fi

git -C "$DEPENDABOT_REPO_CONTENTS_PATH" status --porcelain >/dev/null
echo "case-insensitive local Git operation succeeded"
print-security local-case-insensitive

-- job.yml --
job:
  experiments:
    use_case_insensitive_filesystem: true
  source:
    provider: github
    repo: test/repo
    directory: /
  package-manager: nuget

-- my-repo/project.csproj --
<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk">
  <PropertyGroup>
    <TargetFramework>net8.0</TargetFramework>
  </PropertyGroup>
</Project>
